description: Run an automated multi-point regulatory validation on building plan specifications and return a compliance readiness score, defect warnings, and submission checklist.

building_class.description: Occupancy classification (e.g. "H4 Single Dwelling House", "H3 Multi-Dwelling", "G1 Offices", "F1 Retail"). Default is "H4 Single Dwelling House".

external_wall_thickness_mm.description: External wall thickness in millimetres (standard cavity wall is min. 270 mm).

gully_height_above_ground_mm.description: Height of sewer gully head coping above finished ground level in millimetres (min. 150 mm).

habitable_room_height_mm.description: Specified clear finished floor-to-ceiling height in habitable rooms in millimetres (min. 2,400 mm).

has_renewable_water_heating.description: Whether min. 50% solar water heating or heat pump is specified as required by SANS 10400-XA.

has_rodding_eyes_at_bends.description: Whether rodding eyes or inspection chambers are provided at drainage bends > 45° and junctions.

has_sacap_declaration.description: Whether the drawing title block contains the registered architectural professional full name, registration number, category, and signature.

has_safety_glass_below_800mm.description: Whether safety glass (SANS 1263-1) is specified for all glazing with sill < 800 mm from FFL.

has_sans_forms.description: Whether SANS 10400 Form 1 and Form 2 (if structural work included) are prepared.

municipality.description: Target South African municipality for plan submission (e.g. "City of Johannesburg", "Tshwane", "City of Cape Town", "Ekurhuleni", "eThekwini").

project_name.description: Name of the building or architectural project.

name: pre_check_building_plan
